# EllipticalDot

Module: **QuantumDots** · directory: `QuantumDots/src/Programs` · binary: `QuantumDots/src/Programs/EllipticalDot`

```text
EllipticalDot, version 0.01

Usage: EllipticalDot [options] 

Options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

potential options:
    -M, --M-cell : number of cells in the x direction (default value = 161)
    -N, --N-cell : number of cells in the y direction (default value = 161)
    -H, --H-cell : number of cells in the z direction (default value = 21)
    -X, --cell-xsize : cell size in the x direction in Angstrom (default value = 5.6500000000000004)
    -Y, --cell-ysize : cell size in the y direction in Angstrom (default value = 5.6500000000000004)
    -Z, --cell-zsize : cell size in the z direction in Angstrom (default value = 5.6500000000000004)
    --below : number of cells between well barrier and wetting layer (default value = 2)
    --wetting : number of cells in wetting layer (default value = 1)
    --base : base radius in cell unit (default value = 18)
    --height : height of dot in cell unit (default value = 3)
    --top : top radius in cell unit (default value = 13)
    -a, --anisotropy : anisotropy factor (default value = 0)
    --dot : potential in the dot (default value = -0.40000000000000002)
    --strain : max potential caused by train (default value = 0.01)

Hilbert space options:
    --mu-x : electron effective mass in x direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.070000000000000007)
    --mu-y : electron effective mass in y direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.070000000000000007)
    --mu-z : electron effective mass in z direction (in vacuum electron mass unit) (default value = 0.070000000000000007)
    --nbr-statex : number of states in x direction of the full Hilbert space (no symmetry reduction) (default value = 81)
    --nbr-statey : number of states in y direction of the full Hilbert space (no symmetry reduction) (default value = 81)
    --nbr-statez : number of states in z direction (default value = 21)
    --lowz : lower impulsion in z direction (default value = -10)
    -k, --wave : wave vector of Bloch function in Z direction (in 1/Angstrom unit) (default value = 0)
    --pairX : pair function in X direction
    --pairY : pair function in Y direciton

Lanczos options:
    -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 200)
    -e, --eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates
    --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 5000)
    -d, --disk : enable disk resume capabilities
    -r, --resume : resume from disk datas
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of lanczos iteration (for the current run) (default value = 500)
    --nbr-vector : maximum number of vector in RAM during Lanczos iteration (default value = 400)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help
    -v, --verbose : verbose mode

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
